name: Disciple of the Bow (Scout Archetype)
body:
Disciples of the bow treat archery as a precise and deadly art form.

Way of the Bow (Ex)

A disciple of the bow uses their Wisdom modifier in place of Dexterity for attack rolls with bows and uses their Wisdom modifier in place of their Strength modifier for damage rolls when using composite bows, still limited by the Strength rating of the composite bow. In addition, a disciple of the bow has poor Fortitude saves and good Will saves.

This ability alters the disciple of the bow’s saving throws.

Devoted Sneak Attack (Ex or Su)

A disciple of the bow’s sneak attack deals damage in d8s rather than d6s when using a bow. Sneak attacks with all other weapons use d4s instead.

This ability alters sneak attack.

Deeds (Ex)

The following deeds are available to a disciple of the bow, each deed replaces an existing deed.

Close Combat (Ex)

A disciple of the bow is ready to fight in tight quarters and can spend 1 grit point to attack in melee with a ranged weapon without provoking attacks of opportunity until the start of their next turn. At 6th level, as long as the disciple of the bow has at least 1 grit point they are treated as having the Snap Shot feat with any bow they are wielding. At 10th level this becomes Improved Snap Shot.

This deed replaces the covert finesse deed normally gained at 1st level.

Chasing the Arrow (Su)

A disciple of the bow has an uncanny sense of their weapon and ammunition. By spending 1 grit point when dealing damage to an enemy with an arrow, any attacks made against that creature by the disciple of the bow ignore cover and concealment until the end of the disciple of the bow’s next turn.

This deed replaces the trick shot deed normally gained at 3rd level.

One With the Arrow (Ex)

A disciple of the bow can spend 2 grit points and take a full round action and focus on a single enemy within 120 ft that they can see.

At the end of this action the disciple of the bow makes an attack at their highest base attack bonus. If this attack hits it deals damage normally. Then subtract 5 from the attack roll and compare to the target’s AC, if the new total would hit the attack deals damage again.

Repeat this process until subtracting 5 from the total would result in a miss. Each instance of damage caused by this attack deals additional damage for feats, special abilities, and other bonuses which are not additional dice and can each apply on-hit effects such as poison.

Only the first attack can apply precision damage or is multiplied on a critical hit.

This deed replaces the vital momentum deed normally gained at 7th level.

One With the Bow (Ex)

As long as a disciple of the bow has at least 2 grit points they cannot be disarmed of a bow they are carrying and it cannot be sundered. In addition they treat all bows as though they had a critical threat range of 19-20, this stacks with Improved Critical or the keen magic weapon property. Whenever the disciple of the bow confirms a critical hit against a target they may spend 2 grit points to increase the critical multiplier of the attack by 1. If they do, the attack is also treated as a sneak attack.

This deed replaces the deadly vanguard deed normally gained at 19th level.
